slots.jd.freight-company.about:
Position summary
Whitcombe Logistics Group seeks an Administrative Assistant to support daily office operations at its Memphis, TN location. This on-site role supports staff across the freight business with purchasing, records, reception and scheduling, and ensures that routine office requests are completed accurately and on time.
Minimum: prior office administration experience and working knowledge of Microsoft Office.
Preferred: experience in a freight or logistics setting.
slots.jd.freight-company.duties:
Responsibilities
- Process employee expense reports, verify receipts and route claims for approval.
- Order office supplies, track deliveries and maintain adequate stock levels.
- Take, prepare and distribute meeting notes and follow up on action items.
- Coordinate with vendors on orders, pricing and billing questions.
- Maintain organized physical and electronic records for the office.
- Greet visitors and direct calls to the appropriate staff.
slots.jd.freight-company.needs:
Minimum and preferred qualifications
- 5 or more years of administrative or office support experience.
- Demonstrated experience in vendor coordination, purchase ordering and invoice processing.
- Experience with visitor reception and front desk coverage.
- Ability to record and distribute accurate meeting minutes.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Outlook for email and calendar management.
- Office Administration Certificate required.
slots.r1.b1: Maintain client and office files through consistent records filing, cutting document retrieval time by 25 percent.
slots.r1.b2: Cover front desk phones and greet visitors, and handle purchase ordering for reception supplies between calls.
slots.r1.b3: Order office supplies for the team and handle invoice processing for each delivery, reducing supply costs by 30 percent.
slots.r1.b4: Process staff expense reports and use vendor coordination to resolve billing questions before reimbursement.
slots.r1.i1: Handles phone and visitor coverage at Elmstead Partners, answering calls and welcoming guests at the front desk.
slots.r1.i2: Keeps office files and records in order at Elmstead Partners, from intake and filing through regular upkeep.
slots.r2.b1: Scheduled meetings and appointments for managers and prepared calendars and agendas in Microsoft Word, reducing scheduling conflicts by 10 percent.
slots.r2.b2: Took and distributed notes for staff meetings while also covering visitor reception at the front office.
slots.r2.b3: Arranged travel and event logistics, tracking bookings and budgets in Microsoft Excel and cutting arrangement costs by 35 percent.
slots.r2.b4: Filed and updated office records, including itineraries and receipts from travel booking, so documents stayed easy to find.
slots.r2.i1: Kept filing and records upkeep current for the office at Neighborhood Table Services as an Office Assistant.
slots.r2.i2: Processed expense reports for staff at Neighborhood Table Services, checking receipts and forwarding claims for approval.
slots.summary.1: Administrative support specialist with about 5 years of experience owning recurring office processes from request to completion. Handles purchase ordering, travel booking and document preparation in Microsoft Word with accurate, timely follow-through.
slots.summary.2: Specialist-level administrative support professional with about 5 years of experience taking routine requests through to completion. Skilled in purchase ordering, travel booking and Microsoft Word, closing each task without loose ends.
